learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will identify action words and learn how to correctly use helping verbs like is, am, are, was, and were.]
warm_up_hook: 🏃‍♂️ Jump, run, play, sleep! What do these words have in common? They show action! Let's dive into the world of Verbs, the busy engine words that make our sentences move!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A verb is a 'doing word' or 'action word'. It tells us what a person, animal, or thing is doing. Every complete sentence must have a verb!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🤝 Helping Verbs: Is, Am, Are (सहायक क्रिया - वर्तमान)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Some verbs don't show action, but they 'help' the main verb or tell us how someone is right now. We use 'Am' only with I. 'Is' with singular nouns (He, She, It). 'Are' with plural nouns (We, You, They).

lesson_modules.module_title: 🕰️ Helping Verbs: Was, Were (सहायक क्रिया - भूतकाल)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we talk about the past (yesterday, last week), we use 'Was' and 'Were'. 'Was' is the past form of is/am (used for one). 'Were' is the past form of are (used for many).
examples_or_templates: We [were] at the park on Sunday.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which word in this sentence is the Action Verb? 'The cat chased the mouse.'
❓ Which helping verb fits here? 'Rahul and Amit _____ best friends.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the action verb: 'My grandfather walks in the garden every morning.'
✍️ Fill in the blank with Is, Am, or Are: 'I ____ going to the market, and my sister ____ coming with me.'
subjective_practice.hint: Remember the special rule for 'I', and check if 'sister' is singular or plural.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with Was or Were: 'The apples _____ very sweet.'
subjective_practice.hint: Apples is plural (more than one), so which past helping verb should you use?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎭 Dumb Charades: Action Edition
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write 10 action verbs on small pieces of paper (like dance, eat, sleep, cry, swim). Pick one and act it out without speaking. Ask your family to guess the verb!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Verbs are doing words or action words.
⭐ 'Is' is used for singular subjects; 'Are' is used for plural subjects.
⭐ 'Was' (singular) and 'Were' (plural) are used to talk about the past.
